collective_potentials.definition: Uniform collective displacement energy per primitive formula unit, fixed metal; not an isolated-ion potential.
collective_potentials.fit: K2 fixed by +/-0.01A central force response; one-parameter least-squares quartic fit to energies through0.30A. Forces are an independent prediction check. Ideal reference-site inversion supplies V(-u)=V(u).
collective_potentials.normalization: For N uniformly displaced formula units, total energy and collective-coordinate mass both scale with N; any single-ion/Einstein quantization is a separate model closure.

strain_definition: Centre-normalized central differences [K(+1%)-K(-1%)]/(0.02*K(0)). Hydro epsilon=delta a/a; uniaxial epsilon=epsilon_xx, H displaced parallel x or perpendicular y. Metals fixed, electrons self-consistent.
